idea-plugin.name: Claude Terminal Tab Persistence
idea-plugin.description:
Claude Terminal Tab Persistence

Your Claude Code terminal tabs survive IDE restarts, crashes and reboots.

  • Your sessions restore automatically, right where you left off. Every Claude tab that was open reopens in the same order, under the same name, and resumes its conversation. Close a tab with × and it stays closed.
  • Works with more than one Claude subscription, with or without WSL. On Windows, the Windows Claude and the Claude inside each WSL distro are each tracked and restored through their own installation and login, so each can be on a different account. With more than one, the terminal toolbar shows one Claude button per installation, marked with its platform. Without WSL, it simply uses your local Claude.

Tabs show ✳ <topic> and animate while Claude is thinking. /tab <name> renames one for good.

Slash Commands

  • /tab — set this session's tab name explicitly (persists across restarts)
  • /tabs-status — live sessions + recent eviction backlog for the current project
  • /tabs-backup — explicit sync: write per-sid files for every alive Claude process
  • /tabs-history — browse the eviction backlog and print a resume command
  • /tabs-restore — pick recent sessions by name and reopen them as tabs
  • /tabs-clear — clear active-sessions/ for the current project
  • /tabs-recover — after a crash, rebuild the restore list from what survived and let the plugin reopen the tabs

Requirements: Rider / IntelliJ 2026.1+, Claude Code CLI, Node.js (for the bundled helper scripts).

Coexists with the JetBrains AI Assistant chat tool window (AI Agents panel: Junie / Claude Agent / Codex) and Anthropic's official Claude Code [Beta] plugin. This plugin manages terminal-launched Claude CLI sessions only — chat tabs in the AI Agents panel are managed by JetBrains.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
3.0

Your Claude Code terminal tabs come back.

  • Restart, crash, or reboot — every Claude session that was open in the project is reopened, in order, with its name. Close a tab with × and it stays closed.
  • Named tabs. Tabs show ✳ <topic> and animate while Claude is thinking. /tab <name> renames one for good.
  • WSL included. Sessions running inside a distro are tracked and restored like local ones.
  • Slash commands — /tabs-status, /tabs-history, /tabs-recover and friends, installed automatically.

registryKey.description: Defer to JetBrains AI Assistant / Anthropic Claude Code plugin when present (informational log only).

Clear the IDE terminal's own tab persistence at shutdown so every startup terminal tab is plugin-authored. Prevents IDE-restored tabs from re-running claude as brand-new empty sessions next to the plugin's resumed ones. Disable to get the IDE's own shell-tab restore back.

action.description: Open a new Claude Code session in a plugin-owned terminal tab (durable across restarts).
